application_summary: The application is Swag Labs, an e-commerce web store where users can view an inventory of products, sort them, view individual product details, manage items in a shopping cart, and proceed with purchases.

requirements.title: User Login
requirements.description: Users must be able to log in using valid credentials.
acceptance_criteria: A valid username and password should authenticate the user.
The authenticated user should be taken to the inventory page.
Invalid credentials should not authenticate the user.
assumptions: Valid credentials are provided by the test environment.

requirements.title: Product Browsing
requirements.description: Users must be able to browse products.
acceptance_criteria: Users should be able to sort products.
Users should be able to open a product's details.
assumptions: Products are loaded dynamically on the inventory page.

requirements.title: Add Products to Cart
requirements.description: Users must be able to add products to their shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria: A user can add a product to the cart.
The cart should reflect the selected item count.
The user can open the cart and see selected products.
assumptions: Cart badge updates upon adding an item.

requirements.title: Remove Products from Cart
requirements.description: Users must be able to remove products from their cart.
acceptance_criteria: A user can remove a selected product.
The removed product should no longer appear in the cart.
assumptions: Removal can take place from the cart page or inventory page.

requirements.title: Continue Shopping
requirements.description: Users should be able to continue shopping from the cart.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting Continue Shopping should return the user to the inventory page.
assumptions: Continue Shopping button is available on the cart page.

test_scenarios.title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_scenarios.expected_result: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the inventory page.

test_scenarios.title: Failed Login with Invalid Credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_scenarios.expected_result: User is not authenticated and remains on the login page with an error message.

test_scenarios.title: Sort Products and View Details
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
steps: Select sort option low to high
Click on a product title or image
test_scenarios.expected_result: Products are sorted accordingly and the user opens the product details page.

test_scenarios.title: Add Products to Cart and Verify
preconditions: User is on the inventory page
steps: Click add to cart for multiple items
Click on the shopping cart link
test_scenarios.expected_result: Selected items are added, cart badge reflects count, and items are listed on the cart page.

test_scenarios.title: Remove Product from Cart
preconditions: User is on the cart page with items added
steps: Click the Remove button next to an item
test_scenarios.expected_result: The item is removed from the cart and no longer displayed.

test_scenarios.title: Continue Shopping from Cart
preconditions: User is on the cart page
test_scenarios.expected_result: User is navigated back to the inventory page.

coverage.recommendation: Add login test journeys to the exploration dataset.

matching_journeys: Sort Products and View Item Details
Add Products to Cart and View Cart
Manage Cart Items and Continue Shopping
Manage Cart Items and Continue Shopping

overall_coverage_summary: The explored journeys cover product browsing, cart addition, cart removal, and continue shopping flows fully. However, login functionality (REQ-001) has no matching journey in the provided site map or explored journeys.
critical_gaps: REQ-001 has zero coverage in the current automated journeys as the exploration assumes an already authenticated state.
